category.why: maurices sells its own label (m jeans by maurices) next to outside denim brands, so C is the product it is best known for: jeans. Its homepage title leads with 'Denim' after Women's Fashion, its About page calls it 'a trusted go-to for jeans, tees and special occasion outfits', and women's jeans are the only line with a stored regular-price range ($34.90–$108). It also matches the sibling Buckle and Aeropostale pages. Like-for-like item: women's jeans, which every pick sells. Prices are each store's regular (not marked-down) price as a US shopper is charged; Lane Bryant, American Eagle, Loft, Eloquii and Dressbarn had every jean marked down and render without a price.

author: Ash

copy.intro: You've found the maurices jeans that fit, and now the wash you want is gone in your size and inseam. Or you'd just like a second store that carries a 24 without a hunt. Below are the stores that turn up most on other people's maurices lists, plus-size specialists and mall chains first. Where a store shows regular jeans prices, they sit next to maurices' own $34.90 to $108.

bodies.lane-bryant:
Lane Bryant is the first stop when you want more plus-size jeans than maurices carries. Its jeans run from 12 to 40, well past maurices' 24, and the Genius Straight Leg Jean is an easy first pair.

The fit names are the thing to know. Genius is the line with the most leg shapes, flare and wide leg included. The other two, No-Gap Curvy Fit and Tighter Tummy Fit, describe the fit itself and mostly come in high-rise cuts. It runs more than 400 stores across the US, so trying two fits on at once is easy.

Its jeans start at a 12, though. If you wear a straight size in some cuts and a plus size in others, maurices or Old Navy covers both in one store.
bodies.american-eagle:
American Eagle is the denim-first mall store here, with jeans for men and women ahead of everything else it sells. For a maurices shopper, the fit filter is the useful part. Cuts come in Classic or Curvy, and the AE Low-Rise Classic Straight Jean is a plain one to start with.

That means you can keep a shape you like and change only the fit. Returns get 60 days, a long window for jeans bought online. Sending a pair back by mail costs $5, waived for its top rewards tier and cardholders.

Its free-shipping bar is $75, higher than maurices' $50, so it's worth ordering two pairs at once. If you rely on maurices' extra-short and extra-long inseams, Gap's short, regular and long lengths are the closer match.
bodies.loft:
Loft is the pick for jeans that go to work as easily as they do on weekends. Rivete is its denim line, and the Rivete Mid Rise Wide Leg Jeans are a smart first pair.

Petite, tall and curvy versions sit alongside regular sizes, which stop at 18 or XXL. That's six sizes short of maurices' 24, so come here for the lengths and the office-ready cuts. You can try pairs on in any of its 358 US stores, and it ships abroad as well.

Keep the receipt. Within 30 days you get back what you paid, after that it's store credit, and a mailed return costs $9.95. For sizes past 18 in the same company, Lane Bryant is Loft's Knitwell sister.
bodies.old-navy:
Old Navy lines up with maurices on price better than any store here, with regular jeans at $34.99 to $69.99. Its Curvy High-Waisted Wow Wide-Leg ($34.99) costs about what maurices' cheapest own-label pair does.

Most pairs sit between $44.99 and $54.99 in the OG and Rockstar lines, and the Wow line stays under $40. Regular sizes go from 00 to 30, each in three inseams, and petite and tall come on top. So at the same money, it's the one store here that beats maurices' size range. You can send things back free for 30 days, and its rewards program brings free shipping at $50.

The trade-off is variety, since it only sells its own label. If you liked maurices for Silver Jeans Co. and its other brands, Nordstrom Rack mixes labels instead.
bodies.ashley-stewart:
Ashley Stewart is a plus-size specialist with its own jeans from $54.50 to $79.50. The Fearless High Rise Skinny Jeans ($54.50) are where most of the range starts.

Every pair comes in sizes 10 to 36. Prints and details push the price up, as with the Splatter Print Straight Leg Jeans ($79.50). It has 74 stores across 21 states, and returns are free in store or by mail for 30 days.

Shipping is the cost to plan for. There's no free-shipping minimum, so a single pair ships for $9.95 or more, where maurices ships free over $50. Sizes 28 and up are online only and go back by mail.
bodies.eloquii:
Eloquii is the trend-led choice for plus-size jeans, and it sums itself up as fashion first and fit obsessed. Start with The Naomi Comfort Stretch Straight Leg Jean or The Yvette Rigid Wide Leg Jean. The names give away the fabric, stretch or rigid.

Sizes run from US 10 to 32, well past maurices' 24, with petite and tall bottoms. Returns get 30 days from the ship date, and they're free if you take an e-gift card through Happy Returns.

The catch is shipping. Free US delivery starts at $125, the highest bar on this page, so it's a site for one bigger order. For a single pair, Ashley Stewart covers sizes to 36 for less.
bodies.dressbarn:
Dressbarn suits the maurices shopper after simple, everyday jeans, and most of its denim comes from the Westport Signature line. The Westport Signature Straight Leg Jean comes in regular and plus versions of the same wash, and there's a bootcut five-pocket pair too.

Sizes run 4 to 18 and XS to XL, with some petite styles. Plus sizes reach 5X, one past maurices' 4X. That matters if maurices' plus range runs out just before your size. Orders ship to the 48 contiguous states only.

Returns are the trade-off. You get 30 days, but the refund comes as Dressbarn store credit and you pay the postage. If you'd rather have your money back, Old Navy's returns are free and refunded.
bodies.aeropostale:
Aeropostale suits a maurices shopper who wants a younger, low-rise look, with women's jeans at a flat $64.95. Embellished styles like the Super Low-Rise Baggy Wide Leg Rhinestone Heart Jean are $69.95.

The range leans low and loose, with super low-rise bootcut and ultra wide-leg pairs. Women's sizes run 000 to 20, in short and long lengths too, so the inseam choice echoes maurices'. Shipping is free over $25, half of maurices' threshold, and returns get 60 days. It also has stores in 44 states and Puerto Rico if you'd rather try a rise on first.

It stops at 20, though, and the range is mostly low-rise. If that's not your rise, Old Navy has more lines for less.
bodies.nordstrom-rack:
Nordstrom Rack sells denim labels you know at prices close to maurices' own. Regular jeans cost $39.97 to $79.97, starting with the Democracy Ab Technology Ankle Skinny ($39.97).

As an off-price store, its draw is the brand list. Levi's, Good American, DL1961 and Joe's all turn up, so it's the store for a brand you already know your size in. Joe's The Mia ($79.97) sits at the top. Sizes reach 28W, with petite and plus runs too, so most of maurices' size range is covered.

Orders over $89 ship free, and online orders get 40 days to go back. Each prepaid return label takes $9.95 off the refund, so a Nordstrom or Rack store is the cheaper way to return.
bodies.gap:
Gap is the pick when the inseam matters more than the price, with jeans from $79.95 to $99.95. The High Rise Cheeky Straight ($79.95) is one of the cheapest ways in.

Every size from 000 to 20 comes in short, regular and long inseams, and there are separate petite and tall runs. maurices takes a different route, adding extra-short and extra-long inseams on select styles. You'll find its stores in 46 states, and its rewards program, free to join, brings free shipping over $50.

It costs more, and sizes stop at 20 with one 2X. For a plus size at a lower price, its sister store Old Navy goes up to 30.
bodies.target:
Target is where to grab jeans with the groceries, from $28 to $74.99. Its own Universal Thread Women's High-Rise Vintage Straight Jeans ($38) are the everyday pair to try.

Start with the house labels. Universal Thread pairs cost $28 to $40, and Wild Fable tops out at $35. National brands like Levi's sit higher, topping out at $74.99. Returns get 90 days for most items, and Target-brand pieces get a full year with a receipt.

With two house labels and several national brands on one rack, check whose size chart you're reading. If you want one chart that runs to 30, Old Navy is simpler.
bodies.forever-21:
Forever 21 keeps its full-price jeans between $38 and $44, under the $44.99 where most of maurices' own pairs start. At $38, a straight-leg pair with a drawstring waist is the cheaper of its two styles, and the other is a low-rise bootcut.

There are no Forever 21 stores to walk into anymore. Orders ship to all 50 states, free over $50, and clothing comes in XS to XXL, with Plus as its own section. Its denim section is mostly shorts and skirts, which leaves few full-price jeans to pick from.

Sending something back costs $9.99, and clearance pieces are final. If you want a deeper rack of cheap jeans with stores to try them in, Charlotte Russe has more styles for less.
bodies.charlotte-russe:
Charlotte Russe is the cheapest store on this list for jeans, from $12.99 to $29.99, so every regular pair costs less than maurices' cheapest. The Stretch Mid Rise Push Up Skinny Jean ($12.99) is the lowest price.

Each fit carries a city name. Brooklyn means baggy and London means super baggy, while Paris is the name to look for if you want a wide leg. Most pairs cost $20, and embellished ones reach $25 to $29.99. With more than 190 US stores, you can often try a fit first.

Sizes are the big difference. Its jeans end at a 15 without any plus sizes. You'll also need $100 in your bag for free shipping. If you wear above a 15, Ashley Stewart or Old Navy is the better match.
bodies.universal-standard:
Universal Standard has the widest size range on this page, 00 to 40. The Seine High Rise Skinny Jeans ($118) are the cheapest pair, sold in 27, 30 and 32 inch inseams.

It costs more than maurices, from $118 to $188, with the Bae Boyfriend Crop Jeans at $138. What you pay for is choice. Several styles let you pick the inseam. And you can swap a size free for a whole year. Full-price orders ship free in the US.

Refunds are tighter. Returns get 30 days from shipping and cost $4.50 at a drop-off or $7.50 by mail. If you'd rather spend under $80, Ashley Stewart covers sizes to 36.
bodies.buckle:
Buckle is worth a look for the outside denim brands, since KanCan and Flying Monkey hang at both stores. Regular women's jeans start at $54.99 with the Very J High Rise Wide Leg Jean and climb to $308 for premium labels.

BKE, Miss Me and Levi's fill out the wall, and the Miss Me Universal Boot Stretch Jean ($129) shows where prices head once you leave the basics. It has 440 stores in 42 states, handy when you want to compare two brands in one fitting room. Returns get 60 days, free in store or $6.99 by mail.

Jean waists run about 22 to 38, so it's a store for straight sizes. For plus sizes, Lane Bryant or Eloquii fits better.

closing.heading: How to choose
closing.body:
Start with your size. If maurices' plus range is the reason you shop there, Lane Bryant and Universal Standard both reach 40, and Ashley Stewart goes to 36. Eloquii adds trendier cuts if you're placing a bigger order.

Then set a budget. Under $45, look at Charlotte Russe or Forever 21. Old Navy and Target overlap maurices' own prices. Gap and Universal Standard cost more, and both let you pick the inseam.

For maurices' mix of denim brands, Buckle carries KanCan and Flying Monkey, and Nordstrom Rack sells Levi's and Joe's below their usual prices. If you want jeans that work for the office too, Loft is the one to try.

faqs.q: What stores are similar to maurices?
faqs.a: Lane Bryant, American Eagle and Loft come up most often, followed by Old Navy, Ashley Stewart, Eloquii and Dressbarn. For jeans at similar prices, start with Old Navy or Target. For plus sizes, start with Lane Bryant.

maurices takes returns anytime with the original receipt or order number. Online orders go back with a prepaid label, and $6.95 comes off the refund. Without a receipt, you get merchandise credit at the current price.

faqs.q: How long has maurices been in business?
faqs.a: Since 1931. It opened its first store that year in Duluth, Minnesota, where its headquarters still is, and it now counts about 900 locations across the US and Canada.
faqs.source_query: how long has maurices been in business

faqs.q: How long does maurices take to ship?
faqs.a: Standard US ground shipping takes 3 to 8 business days and costs $8.95, or nothing on orders over $50. Orders to Canada ship at a flat $11.95.
